name: Kosmos-1686
about: Kosmos-1686 (1985-086A), a crewed vehicle (TKS), launched 1985 Sep 27. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1985 Oct 27), held fixed
docked to S13138; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
